executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: dietary cost per resident day ($51.83) was 176% of the Connecticut median ($29.51). Ask what drove the higher dietary cost (contracts, supplies, staffing or a one-time expense).
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $206.24 per resident day (40.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 14.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $493,726, 2.4% of the $20,521,269 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $5,156,753, $51.83 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $1,992,471 (38.6%), allocated fringe $441,293 (8.6%), non-wage costs $2,722,989 (52.8%). Most food spending was a purchased (contracted) service ($2,510,661), so raw food per resident day is not comparable with homes that buy their own food.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $1,224,062, $12.3 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $914,694 (74.7%), allocated fringe $202,587 (16.6%), non-wage costs $106,781 (8.7%).

Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); Cost year 2025 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.
Cost year 2025 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).

recommended_follow_up: Ask the home or DSS how dietary costs are reported on the cost report (in-house staff, purchased services or another department).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
